_schema.note: Shared MUSIC bed manifest. Read by tools/mix_music.py (--bed <id> -> file). Beds are continuous instrumental loops/tracks that sit UNDER the voice (ducked -20 dB relative to VO during speech by default). Files live in media/library/music/clips/ and are NOT committed (binary). Add a bed by dropping the file in clips/ and appending an entry here (or `tools/gen_sfx.py --import --kind music`). Record source + license for every bed: music is the asset most likely to get a reel muted or claimed.

fields.id: stable kebab-case name by MOOD/FUNCTION, not by episode
fields.bpm: tempo, so visual pulses can be aligned (optional)
fields.duration_s: length; mix_music.py loops shorter beds (-stream_loop) to cover the video
fields.loop_safe: true when the file loops without a click (trimmed on a bar boundary)
fields.loudness_lufs: integrated loudness of the file as stored (mix_music.py measures anyway; informational)
fields.has_drums: drums under narration fight the consonants — prefer false for Signal explainers
fields.channels: which channel(s) this bed is approved for: signal | qrosity
